openalex.title: Primer3 on the WWW for General Users and for Biologist Programmers
openalex.abstract: Designing PCR and sequencing primers are essential activities for molecular biologists around the world. This chapter assumes acquaintance with the principles and practice of PCR, as outlined in, for example, refs. 1–4.
